when.test: subjectId != null and principalType != null and principalId != null

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_message ( id, title, content, category, sender_principal_type, sender_principal_id, payload_json, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{entity.id}, #{entity.title}, #{entity.content}, #{entity.category}, #{entity.senderPrincipalType}, #{entity.senderPrincipalId}, CAST(#{payloadJson} AS jsonb), #{entity.createdAt}, 0 )

INSERT INTO notification_delivery ( id, notification_id, subject_id, principal_type, principal_id, status, delivered_at, created_at, updated_at, version, deleted ) VALUES
( #{delivery.id}, #{delivery.notificationId}, #{delivery.subjectId}, #{delivery.principalType}, #{delivery.principalId}, #{delivery.status}, #{delivery.deliveredAt}, #{delivery.createdAt}, #{delivery.updatedAt}, 0, 0 )
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id AS notification_id, d.id AS delivery_id, m.title, m.content, m.category, d.status, m.payload_json::text AS payload_json, d.delivered_at, d.read_at, m.created_at FROM notification_delivery d JOIN notification_message m ON m.id = d.notification_id
ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notification_delivery d WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = #{status}

SELECT d.id, d.notification_id, d.subject_id, d.principal_type, d.principal_id, d.status, d.delivered_at, d.read_at, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.version, d.deleted FROM notification_delivery d JOIN notification_message m ON m.id = d.notification_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 AND d.notification_id = #{notificationId}
ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_delivery SET status = #{nextStatus}, read_at = #{readAt}, updated_at = #{readAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{deliveryId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{currentStatus}
UPDATE notification_delivery d SET status = #{nextStatus}, read_at = #{readAt}, updated_at = #{readAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = #{currentStatus}
